title: Grilled German Sausage Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful recipe for German sausage skewers, perfect for a quick and easy meal. The charred taste of the sausage pairs well with the slight smokiness of the grill.

ingredients.name: charred
ingredients.amount: 4-6 wooden skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes

instructions: 2. Thread sausage, onion, and bell pepper onto skewers.
3. Brush skewers with olive oil, if using.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until sausage is cooked through.
6. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
